summary.text: Thomas Pressly is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 38 (Caddo and DeSoto parishes), and was elected in 2023, according to the official Senate member page. Thomas Pressly is vice chair of the Labor and Industrial Relations Committee.

paragraphs.text: It lists education as C. E. Byrd High School, 2005; Texas Christian University, B.S., 2009; Loyola University New Orleans College of Law, J.D., 2013.

The page lists committee assignments including Labor and Industrial Relations (vice chair), Environmental Quality, Finance, Health and Welfare, the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee, the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget and the Senate Executive Committee, and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
